methodNote: Checks use public Crossref records (with OpenAlex as a backup): DOI lookup, then fuzzy title, author and year matching (±1 year). The trust score is an approximate guide based on the record type, age and citation count — not a quality judgement. "Not found" means we couldn't match the source; confirm it manually before removing it. Verfiai provides verification support, not definitive truth judgments.
